# CircleSeeker CI fixtures

Generated by [`../generate_testdata.py`](../generate_testdata.py) from the
upstream CircleSeeker **v1.6.1** simulator
(`tests/simulation/eccdna_simulator.py`), plus a documented tandem-copy
adaptation for TideHunter / CtcReads-Core on tiny CI data.

Do **not** edit the FASTA files by hand. Regenerate:

```bash
# from modules/nf-core/circleseeker/
python tests/generate_testdata.py \
  --circle-seeker-src /path/to/YaoxinBio/CircleSeeker \
  --out tests/fixtures
```

Checksums and parameters are recorded in `MANIFEST.json`.

Published copies for nf-test live in `nf-core/test-datasets` (or the staging
branch `SiYangming/test-datasets@circleseeker-testdata`) under:

- `data/genomics/homo_sapiens/pacbio/fasta/circleseeker_test_reads.fa`
- `data/genomics/homo_sapiens/pacbio/fasta/circleseeker_test_ref.fa`
